title: StudyBrief · notes to lasting recall
detail: A real browser walkthrough: source-linked practice, confidence, evidence and saved reviews.

title: 1 · Bring your class notes
detail: Notes mode stays tied to your source. The overview is AI-generated; practice quotes are checked against your notes.

title: 2 · A personal revision session
detail: 5 questions generated live with BharatCode. Your notes and progress are saved in this browser.

title: 3 · Confidence before feedback
detail: For this demonstration, we deliberately choose a wrong answer with high confidence.

title: 4 · Reveal the misconception and evidence
detail: The exact quote is present in the notes. Quote matching helps inspection; it does not prove the AI’s interpretation.

title: Answer correctly, but admit uncertainty
detail: Confidence changes the next review interval. Every question can be scored only once per round.

title: 5 · A transparent round result
detail: A practice score and confident-mistake count, without claiming mastery or improved learning.

title: 6 · Reload: your progress survives
detail: Missed concepts remain visible. Wrong answers return in 10 minutes; correct answers return in 1–14 days.

title: Review due respects the schedule
detail: The button is disabled until a question is due. No clock or saved due dates are altered in this recording.

title: 7 · Explore a topic
detail: General-knowledge briefs remain available. Topic mode does not claim source verification or create a review session.

title: 8 · A readable study brief
detail: Key points, a simple explanation and important terms, powered by the live BharatCode model.

title: Explain like I’m 15
detail: An everyday analogy helps make an unfamiliar topic more approachable.

title: 9 · Flip-card practice
detail: Explore the original question-and-answer cards. Saved confidence-based revision is available in notes mode.

title: 10 · Copy or download your brief
detail: Markdown export includes key points, terms, questions, ELI15 and source-linked practice when available.

title: 11 · Delete saved notes and progress
detail: Remove a session from browser storage. There is no account or cross-device sync.

title: Input limits with clear feedback
detail: Long inputs are rejected before generation. Notes mode also requires enough material to create questions.

title: StudyBrief · attempt → inspect → revisit
detail: Open source · BharatCode Build League · source-linked practice and a personal review loop.

title: 12 · Clearly labelled offline mode
detail: A separate server has no live generation enabled. Offline samples demonstrate mechanics, not model quality.

title: Offline samples stay visibly labelled
detail: Students can try the workflow without a key. Real assessments require live BharatCode generation.
